Maya (CS): Quick weekly check-in for AcmeCorp's Dedicated pool (week Mar 10–16).

Maya (CS): GPU hours: 1,820h (-6% w/w). Avg saturation: 82% (peak 96% on Tue 14:30 UTC). Queue depth: avg 12, spikes to 43 at peak. p95 latency: 480ms; p99: 1.1s. Errors: 0.3% (mostly rate-limited / auth). Spend: $26.4k (est).

Evan (Eng-Infra): Noted the Tue spike — looks like nightly batch retraining kicked off. We saw concurrent jobs from tenant-retrain. I pushed a throttle for batch_jitter -> reduced spike by ~60%.

Priya (Acct Exec): Customer flagged renewal risk if latency >500ms for more than 2 weeks. Any mitigations we can commit to?

Jasper (Solutions): Two options: 1) schedule retrain windows off-peak + autoscale buffer; 2) temporary burst capacity add-on (4 GPUs) for 2 weeks. Need ops approval.

Evan (Eng-Infra): Can add autoscale buffer policy: min_idle_gpus=2, burst=4 for 14d. Should keep avg saturation ~60-65%.

Maya (CS): Customer prefers no extra cost initially — will propose retrain window change. Priya, can you confirm if they'd accept a temporary SLA for scheduled downtime during retrain?

Priya (Acct Exec): I'll ask and update by EOD. FYI renewal conversation next Tue.

opsbot: Deploy noted: throttle applied to job 'tenant-retrain' @ 1749998910. Rolling config: /infra/autoscale/policies/tenant-retrain-throttle.

Maya (CS): Action items:
- Priya: confirm acceptance of scheduled retrain window (due EOD)
- Evan: draft autoscale buffer config for review (due Wed)
- Jasper: prepare cost estimate for 2-week burst add-on (due Wed)

Maya (CS): tagging @eng-infra and @solutions for visibility. Will follow up on Wed with updated numbers. :thumbsup:
